Selected work

NeuraScan AI — brain tumour segmentation with Attention U-NetBachelor project, grade A+

A deep learning pipeline that segments brain MRI scans into tumour subregions — edema, necrosis and enhancing tumour — using U-Net and Attention U-Net in PyTorch, reaching around 90% average accuracy across subregions. Around the model I built the tooling a clinician would actually need:

  • A web application that turns each segmentation into an automated clinical report, with ChatGPT and Gemini integrated for AI-assisted interpretation of the results.
  • An interactive AI avatar that presents and narrates the generated report.
  • A retrieval-augmented (RAG) chatbot and a 3D brain visualisation for exploring scan results.

Python · PyTorch · Gradio · Gemini & ChatGPT APIs · RAG · 3D visualisation
